snippet.title: Nanomon Virtual Pet - Official Release Date Trailer | The MIX Summer Showcase 2025
snippet.description:
Nanomon Virtual Pet gets a new trailer and release date announcement. Check out the latest Nanomon Virtual Pet for this upcoming idle creature collector game to see gameplay and more. Nanomon Virtual Pet will be available on PC (Steam, Epic Games Store, GoG) on June 24.
Nanomon are tiny, virtual pets who hang out in the corner of your screen. Train, explore, discover, and play with your Nanomon so they can evolve into the perfect companion! Only the best, most attentive trainers will help their Nanomon achieve their life goal!
